title: Community Workshops
description: Empowering communities through design and technology workshops

items.title: TechLadies x WomenDevsSG Mentorship 2025
items.description: Empowering women with career guidance from industry professionals in Software Engineering, UI/UX Design, Data Science, and Product Management. Features one-on-one mentoring and Speed Mentorship pilot program.

items.title: (Women Devs SG) AI Talks: Building Robust Software with AI
items.description: Live demos and case studies on leveraging AI tools for better code quality, testability, and preventing IT incidents. Featuring presentations on AI copilots, agentic AI, and co-creating with Cursor.

items.title: (Women Devs SG) Building Modern Software Applications #01
items.description: Exploring Fluent localization system for natural translations, plus shift-left and fail-fast strategies in software development. Featuring talks on Continuous Delivery and deploying global-ready, resilient software.
